findings: Fig 3.2 labels the private data '_private_variable' with one underscore, which is Python's protected convention; private members use two underscores, so the original figure uses self.__balance.
Fig 3.6's caption ('the same function behaving differently') describes an example, but the figure shows the two types of polymorphism; the original figure shows both.

The payment example lists four payment types but describes only the net-banking implementation; an added code example shows overriding for two of them. UPI is glossed, with Pakistan's Raast as the local equivalent.

The text mentions super() without an example; an added Puppy example shows it. The OCR's code is garbled, and every listing was checked against the page images. Multilevel text misprints 'drived'. Check questions and their answers were written for the lesson and need the second-person review.
